findings.title: Diagonal biased draws overshoot the group radius — 'the candidate JOINS the estate' overclaims for dist 4-5 diagonal draws
findings.evidence: dir := growth_dir_pick(rng) / dist := rng_range(rng, lo, hi) / pos = t.node_pos[anchor_slot] + dir * dist — vs Euclidean adjacency (growth.odin:185-187) and dirs incl {1,1} (growth.odin:405-410)
findings.detail: Diagonal dir x dist 4-5 = Euclidean 5.66/7.07 > radius_tiles 5, so ~1/3 of biased draws land outside the anchor's radius and may not join the derived cluster. E31-safe and deterministic; the bias is weaker than documented; the estates+isolated pin still passes on the pinned seed.
findings.recommended_fix: Clamp dist for diagonal dirs to floor(radius/sqrt(2)) (integer), or soften the comment/PR-body claim to Chebyshev-radius landing.

findings.title: growth_groups parsed with jint (silent float truncation + i32 wrap), not the jint_strict bar its 5.9 sibling enforces
findings.evidence: b.growth_groups.bias_prob_permille = jint(gobj, "bias_prob_permille", -1) x5 — vs jint 'case json.Float: return i32(x)' (catalog.odin:~1131) and sibling 'b.cap_fraction_permille, _ = jint_strict(...)' (catalog.odin:774)
findings.detail: A decimal 750.5 silently loads as 750; a 2^32+N value wraps through the i32 cast and can pass the range checks — the exact class jint_strict was hardened against. Shipped values are integers, so no live bug; the ODN-10 integer bar is silently bendable at the data boundary.
findings.recommended_fix: Parse all five keys with jint_strict, reject on !ok, add decimal + wrap fail-fast rows in catalog_test.

findings.title: estate_surge.dem header quotes banner copy that does not match the shipped crises.json string
findings.evidence: # the banner reads "Add a parallel pipe or a higher tier on the group / # uplink's path — the surge is an aggregation event" — vs data/crises.json: "Add a parallel pipe or a higher tier on the group uplink's path."
findings.detail: Stale draft copy quoted in the blessed golden's documentation; the shipped banner is shorter.
findings.recommended_fix: Quote the shipped preventive_redesign verbatim in the .dem header.

findings.title: max_members draw-cap branch unpinned — deleting the eligibility check fails no test
findings.evidence: if i32(gview.size[i]) >= cat.balance.growth_groups.max_members { continue } — no *_test.odin asserts cap exclusion or the all-estates-full fallback (grep: max_members in tests = loader rows only)
findings.detail: The ruling's 3-8 size band is enforced only by this branch; a regression removing it would pass the suite. P2 gap.
findings.recommended_fix: Pin a seed/fixture where an estate reaches max_members and assert it leaves the eligible set (fresh estate starts via the uniform family).

findings.title: Concentration control run discards its spawn total (_ = total_wo) — no volume sanity check on the attribution baseline
findings.evidence: estate_wo, total_wo := run_estate_concentration(42, 0, W) / _ = total_wo — while total_w > 1000 IS asserted
findings.detail: If the zeroed-weight control spawned little streaming, the estate_w > estate_wo comparison could attribute noise to the weight.

findings.title: radius_tiles has no upper bound — an oversized radius silently merges all terminals into one derived cluster
findings.evidence: if b.growth_groups.radius_tiles <= GROWTH_MIN_SEP_TILES { return ... } — floor only; every sibling knob has both bounds
findings.detail: A hand-tuned radius of 500 loads clean: union-find merges the map into one 'estate', the weight bonus applies map-wide, and biased dist draws up to 500 burn the attempt budget.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a ceiling (small multiple of the connect span or a fixed cap) to the fail-fast validation.

findings.title: Uniform-family placement draw duplicated verbatim in two branches of growth_plan_demand
findings.evidence: The 8-line router/dir/dist block appears byte-identically at 573-581 (no-eligible-cluster fallback) and 591-599 (coin-fail else)
findings.detail: Two verbatim copies of the same rng draw sequence must stay in lockstep; editing one shifts the E10 interleaving silently.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract growth_uniform_candidate(t, nj, span, rng) and call from both branches.

findings.title: Credit-starvation neutralization of the group weight documented but unpinned
findings.evidence: // (under credit-starvation the 5.9 cap alone forces every terminal to its credit rate and no weight can move the shares) — no test pins this boundary
findings.detail: A future change letting the weight move shares under starvation would pass the suite. P3 gap; the credit-rich regime is fully pinned.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a starved fixture asserting estate share with weight 250 equals the zeroed control on the same seed.
